physics-killer-10.title: Advanced Photoelectric Effect: Frequency vs Kinetic Energy and Work Function
physics-killer-10.topic: Advanced Photoelectric Effect: Frequency vs Kinetic Energy and Work Function
physics-killer-10.goal: Analyze the principles of Advanced Photoelectric Effect: Frequency vs Kinetic Energy and Work Function and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.
physics-killer-10.material: Di ceribandina bandora fotoelektrîk de ku ronahiya yekreng li ser pelikeke metalê tê tavêtin, encamên pîvandina enerjiya kînetîk a herî zêde ya fotoelektronan ji bo du frekansan wekî tabloya jêrîn in. Dema frekans $7.5\times10^{14}\,\mathrm{Hz}$ be $E_k=1.0\,\mathrm{eV}$, dema frekans $9.0\times10^{14}\,\mathrm{Hz}$ be $E_k=1.6\,\mathrm{eV}$. Sabîta Planck $h=4.0\times10^{-15}\,\mathrm{eV\cdot s}$ ye (nirxa texmînî ji bo pirsê).
